summary_for_children: An-Naba' means The Great News. It asks people to look at signs: the earth, mountains, sleep, night and day, the sun, rain and gardens.
world_title: The Earth as a Resting Place
environment_concept: A walk through the signs of 78:6-16: a soft meadow with a resting bench (78:6), mountains standing like stakes (78:7), a starry canopy that covers like clothing (78:10), a bright sun disc like a burning lamp (78:13), and gardens of vines grown thickly together (78:16). The Day of 78:17-40 is not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A meadow bench, stake-like peaks, a starry cloth canopy, a sun disc, entwined vine arbours.

unique_world.visual_theme: A wide windy plain at the foot of high mountains, late in the day, with a loose tent flapping

primary_mechanic.text: Drive six tent pegs round the tent, each straight across from the last before starting a new pair (out of turn the tent is pulled over and the peg slips out); when all hold, the tent stops swaying and you rest inside (78:6-7 mountains as pegs; 78:9-11 sleep a rest, night a covering).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the plain, pegging the tent and resting, then a reading near the tent
world_assets: tent with six ropes and pegs
environment_behaviour: the tent sways less with each peg
ropes tighten to each driven peg
unique_world.learning_objective: Know the signs of 78:6-16: the earth a resting place, the mountains as pegs, sleep a rest

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Great News
story_library.children_narration: The Quran asks us to look at mountains, the earth, sleep, night, day, and rainfall. These are familiar parts of life, but each can inspire wonder. Surah An-Naba connects these signs to the great news of resurrection and accountability.

world_idea.title: The Earth and Sky Museum
world_idea.description: Travel through a series of large interactive natural exhibits, from mountains and clouds to night and day.
